changeSet.author: Abdula Basnukaev
changeSet.comment: Сессия 56: колонки alminasa на hd_hadiths/hd_narrators + UNIQUE external_id
changeSet.sql:
ALTER TABLE hd_hadiths ADD COLUMN external_source varchar(30), ADD COLUMN external_id varchar(40), ADD COLUMN hadith_type varchar(40), ADD COLUMN chapter_ar text, ADD COLUMN sub_chapter_ar text, ADD COLUMN full_text_ar text; ALTER TABLE hd_hadiths ADD CONSTRAINT hd_hadiths_external_unique UNIQUE (external_source, external_id);
ALTER TABLE hd_narrators ADD COLUMN external_source varchar(30), ADD COLUMN external_id varchar(40), ADD COLUMN tabaqa varchar(120), ADD COLUMN grade_text text, ADD COLUMN born_on_text text, ADD COLUMN died_on_text text; ALTER TABLE hd_narrators ADD CONSTRAINT hd_narrators_external_unique UNIQUE (external_source, external_id);
